notes.title: v1.1.3 - Reworked Zone Functionality
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

One of the biggest requests in My Little Life is to allow characters to have multiple zones. So here it is!
In this update each character can have as many zones as you like.

This allows for so much more freedom when building their little homes. Such as having their work spaces and living spaces separate.

I also completely reworked the way the zones are set and cleared, hopefully making it much easier to use.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/7b6f5254c1a51cf0356e522b0ee98fa340c1513e.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/7b6f5254c1a51cf0356e522b0ee98fa340c1513e.gif[/img][/url]
(Zones do not need to be connected to each other!)

Other things in this update:
* A new secret code for the weird machine
* An alert system for in-game update prompts
* Some small bug fixes and optimizations


Why no communal zones?
Communal zones have been requested quite a lot, but I'm still considering how I could add them without causing other issues with game progression.

For instance, the game could be completed very fast if you had one area that fulfilled all the needs for every character. I'm still not completely against the idea, I'm just thinking of a way that can do it without completely breaking the progression of the game.

I have ideas that I'm experimenting with. I'll keep you updated.

In the meantime, communal items are still useful for filling that void.

Hope you like this update, 
Thanks for all your support.

Love ya'll.

-Stevie

notes.title: New Farming Update!
notes.content:
[h2]It ain't much, but it's honest work.[/h2]
One of the most popular content requests was a farming career, so here it is.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/83fe4068676bff1b4876933ef68cacdcde501772.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/83fe4068676bff1b4876933ef68cacdcde501772.gif[/img][/url]

This is update will go live on the 28th of February (2 days time) at approximately 3pm GMT.

This update features over 60 new items related to farming. Including crops, pots, wheelbarrows, farming tools, and so much more.

This career is one of the more interesting ones and works differently from most of the others. The farmer only receives payment when they harvest a crop that you have placed. The crops each have their own characteristics for you to discover. Some take longer to grow but are worth more when harvested, and some do not need watering often.

This career is one of the new starting careers and is quite strong as it allows you to take advantage of the outside area of the suburbs map early on.

The farmer can also can also grow crops inside, for those of you who like the City map. When a crop is placed inside it is instead placed in a pot.

Also included in this update is a cute pet that unlocks if you own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3167550/Tiny_Pasture/]Tiny Pasture[/url] on Steam. Check out the My Little Life/ Tiny Pasture bundle if you haven't already. Both can be played at the same time.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/3bd79fbe3e0028dd6f4b0d9aafd075ffd36d6d9b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/3bd79fbe3e0028dd6f4b0d9aafd075ffd36d6d9b.gif[/img][/url]


[h2]Here are the patch notes:[/h2]

* New career (Farming)
* 60+ new items
* New Hidden secrets
* 2 new achievements
* New item filter for lights
* New item filter for furniture with slots (like shelves and bookcases)
* Fixes for some small & rare bugs
* Updated Chinese language support for previously added items.
* New pet for owners of Tiny Pasture


In other news, we have sold over 37k copies in the first 26 days. Thanks so much for all your support. <3

-Stevie

notes.title: Week 1 Recap
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

That was a pretty hectic launch week. Overall I'm super happy with how everything turned out and really thankful for all your support. 

[b][h2]Here are some stats:[/h2][/b]
[b]29,000[/b] sales
[b]3,178 [/b]Supporter pack sales
[b]66,215 [/b]Wishlists
[b]4 hours 22 minutes[/b] Median play time 
[b]7[/b] Updates
[b]1[/b] overworked but very happy developer. (Me)

Speaking of builds, I just made another quick update that fixes one of the last scary issues with the game:

[h2][b]New in version 1.0.7[/b][/h2]
[Fixed] A crash when characters interact with career items.

For those who haven't been keeping up to date, here is the full list of changes and fixes made since release, all based off of your feedback.
[h2][b]What's changed since release[/b][/h2]
* Logo appears in Chinese when the game is set to Chinese
* Ambient sounds can now be turned down (counts as SFX)
* Removed one of the annoying coin dropping sounds when earning currency.
* Added Better tool tips for various buttons
* Enabled item names for all languages (Needs localization texting on non-english langauges)
* Added a tip to ensure player knows to click and drag zones (This contributed to most of the "My people stopped working" posts.)
* Removed the "I see you" message as it seemed to occasionally appear to legit Steam user.
* You can now right click to cancel zone placing.
* You can now move items while props are placed on-top of them without having to move them off first.
* Update UI to make it clearer how to place stairs properly
* [Fixed] The bass guitar sound only playing from the left ear
* [Fixed] The guitar Fulfillment task progression not save/loading.
* [Fixed] Lots of Japanese font characters were missing when inputting custom names.
* [Fixed] Zones 0 width or height can no longer be placed
* [Fixed] Some issues with easel items causing the game to crash
* [Fixed] Clock blocked on City Mode
* [Fixed]  Shelves that are already placed clipping ceilings can now be sold/moved.
* [Fixed]  Shelves can no longer be placed in the ceiling. (Or any item with slots can't be placed if their slots will extend into the next floor.)
* [Fixed]  The red workbench was awarding pottery skill instead of Cars.
* [Fixed] Rare crash when characters would interact with career items
* [Fixed]  Some workshop items had prop slots, but the UI wouldn't show them
* [Fixed]  Previously placed Lunar new year posters should now be sellable/moveable
* [Fixed] Fixed the forever ringing phone sound
* [Fixed] Gifts can now be selected in vertical mode
* [Fixed]  language settings resetting when entering the game/loading a file.
* [Fixed]  keyboard sound not stopping when the iteration is interrupted
* [Fixed]  sleeping sound not stopping when the iteration is interrupted
* [Fixed]  Localization bugs on the choose a career menu.
* [Fixed]  Lunar new year poster not selling, and can be placed anywhere.
* [Fixed]  Lunar new year present respawning all the time, unlocking the same items and blocking other "gifts" from dropping.
* [Fixed] Some Korean appearing while the game is in Chinese

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]Massive news time![/h1]

My Little Life is releasing on January 31st 2025!
[previewyoutube=hJmUgpZmj1E;full][/previewyoutube]

Super excited to share the game with everyone, and to show what I have been cooking up for the past year.

[h2]Some answers to questions I have got:[/h2]
[b]Will the demo save files be usable in the main game?[/b]
The demo save files are technically usable in the main game but I [b]highly[/b] recommend not to try. A lot of systems have changed as well as progression. For instance if there is a new item in the main game that is unlocked via an early career that was already completed in the demo, then they will become unobtainable.

[b]How much will the game cost?[/b]
Hard to answer due to the location base costing that Steam uses, but I have settled on a cost that I think should be affordable for most.

[b]Will the game get updates after release[/b]
Almost definitely, I have so many ideas on what I want to add to the game. And the game will of course receive bug fixing patches regardless. 

[b]Where's the demo gone?[/b]
I made the decision to remove the demo from Steam as the save files from the demo won't be transferable to the main game, and I didn't want to have people sink many hours into the demo right before the main game comes out. If you really wanted to continue playing the demo that there is a version on [url=https://9fingergames.itch.io/my-little-life-demo]itchio [/url]still lingering around.

Thanks for all your support! 

I do have one request;
[b]Please share this game to your friends, colleagues, classmates, everyone. [/b]The future if the game depends on it. The more people that buy the game, the more updates it will get.

Love you all.
Stevie
